verdict.rationale: smolagents documents sandboxed execution of agent code via Modal, Blaxel, E2B, or Docker, plus a hardened LocalPythonExecutor with an import allowlist. A hands-on report shows that allowlist blocking a non-authorized import (matplotlib). This isolates agent-generated code from the host, but nothing shows a separate test environment or protection of production data, which is the core of the story. Missing for 10: explicit test/staging environment or mock-data separation from production data, detailed sandbox setup docs in evidence, and independent corroboration of the remote sandboxes.
